theme_title_zh: retail investor / 自主管理个人投资组合的散户投资人 在 portfolio_monitoring_and_idea_generation 中的 workflow_friction + information_overload + tool_inadequacy 需求
persona_group: retail investor / 自主管理个人投资组合的散户投资人
theme_summary_zh: 现有工具无法满足投资研究的完整工作流需求：Seeking Alpha内容质量参差不齐、噪音过多；ChatGPT/Perplexity Finance过于以聊天机器人为中心，缺乏合理工作流；Deep Research类工具缺乏用户控制且输出过于冗长。即便只是季度调仓，跟踪组合风险和研究新标的也耗费大量时间和精力。 找到了相关候选，但尚未抽取出足够痛点证据。
representative_quotes: Seeking Alpha is a chore to go through with too much generic content, inconsistent quality and noise. ChatGPT and Perplexity Finance lack a decent workflow (too chatbot centric). Deep research might seem great at first, but the lack of control and verbosity becomes a pain very quickly.

group_key: retail investor / 自主管理个人投资组合的散户投资人

representative_quotes: most analysts operate in a chaos of 50+ browser tabs, scattered excel models, and disconnected notion notes.

theme_title_zh: individual investor / retail investor with framework-driven research workflow 在 idea generation / investment screening 中的 workflow_inefficiency 需求
persona_group: individual investor / retail investor with framework-driven research workflow
theme_summary_zh: 投资者在进行个人研究时，希望能按照特定投资大师（巴菲特、林奇、索罗斯等）的投资框架来过滤和生成投资标的，但缺乏自动化工具支持这一流程，只能手动查阅原则并逐一对照，效率低下。 未找到支持该 seed 的新增证据。
representative_quotes: The idea came from my own investing workflow: I often look at companies through the lens of specific investors (Buffett, Lynch, Taleb, etc.). I wanted a tool that could generate investment ideas filtered through those frameworks.

group_key: individual investor / retail investor with framework-driven research workflow

theme_title_zh: investment analyst / vc due diligence researcher / finance professional 在 pre-investment due diligence / market research 中的 time_cost + quality + access_cost 需求
persona_group: investment analyst / vc due diligence researcher / finance professional
theme_summary_zh: 投资和咨询团队每周需投入大量时间进行公司、市场和产品研究，该工作时间敏感且耗费精力。大型金融机构将此类工作外包给第三方服务商，每个项目收费数千美元，且往往速度慢、质量低；小型团队则因预算不足和工作量不稳定而无法使用这类资源。以竞争格局分析为例，分析师需花费约2小时手动挖掘信息。 未找到支持该 seed 的新增证据。
representative_quotes: investment and consulting teams sink many hours a week into researching companies, markets, and products. This work is time-sensitive and exhausting, but crucial to big decisions like company acquisitions or pricing model changes. At large financial services firms, much of this work is offshored to external providers, who charge thousands of dollars per project and are often slow and low-quality. Small teams lack the budget and consistent flow of work to employ these resources.

group_key: investment analyst / vc due diligence researcher / finance professional
